status: exact finite linear-map search; not a coloring or HN claim

source.title: A Moser-spindle-free 5-chromatic unit distance graph on 2131 vertices in the plane
source.author: Jan Kristian Haugland
source.used_sections: Section 2 defines P_j,Q_j,R_j and the induced 21-point graph; Section 4 Table 2 motivates the lattice-coloring question.
source.scope_note: The source itself says the finite-ball observations do not prove extension to all of L.

field.reduction: coordinatewise rational reduction modulo 2; all observed denominators are odd

search.interpretation: At stage m, a listed pair (a,b) means x -> (a dot x,b dot x) is nonzero on every reduced direction in the union of r^j mu_42 for 0<=j<=m. No failure implies anything about arbitrary 4-colorings or chi(R^2).
